Qualcomm SGSR2 two-pass fragment shaders, BSD-3-Clause. Upstream https://github.com/SnapdragonGameStudios/snapdragon-gsr at d926f074bcb9d714e179f1ce0fcb9ee2eeb5074e. Originals retained unchanged. tools/embed_sgsr2.py generates the Vulkan adaptations and C literals in shaders.inc: GLSL450, push constants128bytes, image bindings0..2, UV from fragment coordinates, no object velocity input (camera reprojection only). Missing animated-object vectors are a prototype limitation. No claim of full-scene temporal correctness.

Further explicit adaptations: REQUEST_NDC_Y_UP for the negative-height geometry viewport; reset overrides temporal alpha even for signed filter sums; optional amplified history-contribution diagnostic. Kernel bias and optional output SMAA are runtime experiments in exec.c. The generated code differs from the vendor sample; originals remain the reference.

The vendor's optional nine-tap neighbourhood is available as a separate generated shader (`LARECOMP_SGSR2_HQ=1`). The default five-tap program keeps that branch compile-time disabled. Nine taps alone did not replace output SMAA satisfactorily in the Quest trial; it is not the user preset. History diagnostics use independent bit2. See the Android SGSR2 report for captures, costs and limits.
